meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Microsoft Teams 渠道接入 NanoClaw:复制并注册 Teams 适配器、装固定版本依赖、构建并测试;再用 Teams CLI 建机器人,把凭据写进 .env。
howto.when: 当你提到 Microsoft Teams 频道、群聊、私信,或要求把助手接入 Teams 时触发;description 只写「通过 Chat SDK 添加 Teams 频道集成」,未列触发词。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制并注册适配器、装依赖、跑注册测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 建机器人,名字叫 NanoClaw
say.note: 注册 Entra 应用,把凭据写进 .env

say.text: 把助手接线到我这个 Teams 账号
say.note: 确认后机器人会先给你的 Teams 私信

howto.what_en: Installs Microsoft Teams channel support for NanoClaw: copies and registers the Teams adapter, installs a pinned dependency, builds and tests, then uses the Teams CLI to create a bot, store credentials in .env and wire it to a Teams account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Microsoft Teams channels, group chats or DMs, or ask to connect the assistant to Teams. The description only says it adds Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

say_en.text: Please add the Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then builds and tests

say_en.text: Create the Teams bot with the Teams CLI, name it NanoClaw
say_en.note: Registers the Entra app and stores credentials in .env

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account
say_en.note: The bot messages you first in Teams DMs
